messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — I noticed the API reference shows request_id as a JSON field in the /v1/generate examples, but our OpenAPI spec defines it as a header (in: header). This breaks the auto-generated curl examples and confuses SDK users.
kevin: Can you paste the current curl + OpenAPI fragments so we can see the exact mismatch?
amanda: Curl on the page today:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-mini","prompt":"hello","request_id":"abc-123"}'
```
OpenAPI snippet shows header parameter:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: X-Request-Id
    in: header
    required: false
    schema:
      type: string
    example: abc-123
```
kevin: Yep. Runtime expects X-Request-Id header (nginx normalizes to lowercase). Some older examples used request_id in body for quick demos. We should standardize on the header.
lucas: +1 for header. Also include both curl and python-sdk snippets. Python currently accepts client.generate(..., request_id="...") — that convenience maps to the header. Keep that but add a mapping note.
sarah_p: For OpenAPI, add example value for the header and remove request_id from example bodies. That will also fix server codegen and sample clients.
jordan: I'll open a tiny docs PR to: 1) remove request_id from example request bodies, 2) add X-Request-Id header examples for generate/stream/rerank endpoints, 3) add a short note in SDK snippets that request_id param sets the header. Any objections?
amanda: One extra ask — include a one-liner explaining why it's a header (propagation across proxies/tracing), helps infra folks.
kevin: Also add a note for batching: header applies per-client-request, not per-batched-item.
jordan: Will do. Opening PR rwd/docs#5501 and tagging @amanda @kevin @sarah_p.
docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5501 — CI: docs build passed, linkcheck failed on one anchor (will be fixed in the PR).
amanda: Thanks, will review by EOD. If anyone finds other occurrences of request_id in bodies (old examples, snippets), drop file paths here and I'll add them to the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
lucas: Found one in rerank examples: docs/reference/rerank.md (line ~120) — looked like copy/paste.
sarah_p: Also check JS and Go snippets. Keep the parity note to avoid repeating the mistake in multiple languages.
jordan: Aiming to push the update in a few hours, doc-only change so low risk.
kevin: After Amanda merges, I'll update the sample example generator so it emits header-based examples by default.
amanda: Great, closing loop — thanks everyone!
